name: Juice Delivery
summary: In Darkshire, you carry Zombie Juice west to a hermit on Duskwood’s edge. Tavernkeep Smitts says the brew is stout enough to raise the dead. It is meant to warm Abercrombie, though its potency raises questions.

sections.title: A Dubious Concoction
sections.body: Tavernkeep Smitts brews a legendary draught in Darkshire. When the Zombie Juice is ready, he hands you the bottle and warns you to handle it gently. He says the concoction is stout enough to raise the dead. You carry it across the haunted forest to an eccentric loner, in what seems a simple act of charity.

sections.title: The Hermit's Slip
sections.body: Abercrombie lives in a shack on the edge of the woods, where you bring him the volatile brew. The frail recluse says he needs the liquor to warm his aching bones through Duskwood’s freezing, fog-choked nights. As he takes the bottle, he nearly thanks you for your “foolishness,” then quickly corrects himself and praises your “kindness.” His slip hints that he has plans for the brew beyond an evening drink.

faq.answer: Zombie Juice is an extremely potent brew made by Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. He says it is stout enough to wake the dead, far stronger than ordinary spirits.
Abercrombie, an eccentric old hermit, requests the Zombie Juice. He lives in a lonely shack near Duskwood’s western boundary.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want the drink?
faq.answer: Abercrombie claims he needs the drink to keep warm during Duskwood’s bitterly cold, damp nights. When he receives it, his slip of the tongue hints at sinister designs for the brew.
Tavernkeep Smitts brews Zombie Juice himself at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in the heart of Darkshire, once he has the pungent ingredients he needs.
Abercrombie’s isolated shack is in western Duskwood, just north of Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: What does Abercrombie do next after receiving the juice?
faq.answer: After securing the Zombie Juice, Abercrombie keeps imposing on gullible travelers. He sends them into Raven Hill Cemetery to gather ghoul ribs for a ghoulish effigy he claims will keep the undead away.

angles.text: As an Alliance courier, you brave Duskwood’s perilous roads for Darkshire’s citizens. Trusting every hermit in the woods can bring unforeseen trouble.
As a cook, you can see that Tavernkeep Smitts’ Zombie Juice recipe relies on pungent, unconventional ingredients and tests what belongs in a tavern beverage.
